Navigation.footer_desc: Free professional veterinary care for every animal in need. Serving Hyderabad and the twin cities since July 2024.

hero.title: Compassionate Care for Every Animal
hero.subtitle: MAA Saraswati Veterinary Hospital provides world-class, completely free veterinary care — because every animal deserves to heal.

services.heading: Our Veterinary Services
services.subtext: Comprehensive medical care for all animals — completely free of charge to their owners.

cattle.title: Cattle & Livestock
cattle.description: Complete care for cattle, buffaloes, sheep, and goats — from routine checks to emergency treatment.

dogs.title: Canine Care
dogs.description: Specialised treatment for dogs including surgery, vaccinations, and post-operative care.

poultry.title: Poultry & Birds
poultry.description: Expert care for poultry, backyard birds, and exotic birds with disease prevention programmes.

surgery.title: Surgery
surgery.description: Advanced surgical capabilities in our modern operation theatre with full anaesthesia support.

ambulance.title: Ambulance Service
ambulance.description: Free 24/7 emergency ambulance covering twin cities and up to 100 km from Hyderabad.

lab.title: Lab Diagnostics
lab.description: On-site laboratory for blood tests, cultures, biopsies, and rapid diagnostic results.

mission_vision.heading: Our Mission & Vision
mission_vision.subtext: Guided by compassion, driven by purpose — everything we do is for the animals.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide compassionate, professional, and absolutely free veterinary care to every animal in need — regardless of the owner's financial situation — ensuring that no animal suffers due to lack of funds.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A Hyderabad where every animal has access to world-class medical care, supported by modern infrastructure, skilled professionals, and a caring community committed to animal welfare.

recent_csr.heading: Recent CSR Activities
recent_csr.subtext: Taking our services beyond the hospital walls to communities and animals that need them most.

vaccination.title: Free Vaccination Camp — Rangareddy District
vaccination.description: Organised a free vaccination camp vaccinating over 500 cattle and 200 dogs against rabies and foot-and-mouth disease.

awareness.title: Rural Animal Health Awareness Programme
awareness.description: Conducted awareness sessions in 5 villages on animal nutrition, disease prevention, and when to seek veterinary care.

rescue.title: Flood Relief Animal Rescue
rescue.description: Deployed our 24/7 ambulance and rescue team to assist and treat over 100 animals affected by recent heavy rains.

donate_callout.heading: Help Us Provide Free Care
donate_callout.subtext: Every rupee you donate funds medicine, surgery, and ambulance services for animals who have no one else to turn to.
donate_callout.impact_line: ₹500 covers one surgery · ₹1,000 stocks medicines for a week · ₹5,000 runs our ambulance for a month

hero.title: Our Team
hero.subtitle: The qualified, compassionate professionals who make free veterinary care a reality every single day.

meet.heading: The People Behind MAA
meet.subtext: Our doctors, technicians, and support staff bring expertise, dedication, and genuine care to every patient.

volunteer.heading: Want to Make a Difference?
volunteer.subtext: We welcome veterinary professionals, students, and passionate volunteers who want to contribute to our mission of free animal care.

hero.title: CSR Activities
hero.subtitle: Beyond our hospital — reaching animals and communities who need us most.

impact.heading: Our CSR Activities
impact.subtext: A timeline of the camps, rescues, and awareness drives our team has conducted.

partner.heading: Want to Organise a Camp in Your Area?
partner.subtext: We work with local governments, NGOs, and communities to bring free veterinary care to where it is needed most.

hero.title: Contact Us
hero.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you — for enquiries, donations, volunteering, or emergencies.
